title: POST /register handler
description: Decode, validate, create, push to CRM best effort, respond.

constraints: CRM push uses a 2 second context timeout and failures are logged at warn.
Response bodies are JSON with Content-Type application/json.

outputs.description: On validation failure; email is checked before username

errors.returns: still 201; warn log line with the error, no email in the log

side_effects: Calls crm.Push with a 2s timeout derived from r.Context()

tests.name: valid returns 201
tests.given: fake store and fake CRM, body a@b.co/abc
